purpose: Teach: 教頭/推し進め/確証/製本/スキャナ/試験場/防火/配色

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 地元の教頭先生に職場体験を依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's reach out to the local vice principal about arranging a work-experience placement.
lines.style: Businesslike, decisive. Flat, efficient opening. No inflection—stating a next action item. Brief pause for acknowledgment. Forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新方針を推し進める社内チームを編成しました
lines.en: Yes. I've assembled an internal team to drive the new strategy forward.
lines.style: Steady, confirmatory. Slight emphasis on 「assembled」—small pride in execution. Pace matches hers but relaxed. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 確証のないままお客様に約束はしないようにしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we don't promise anything to the client without solid confirmation first.
lines.style: Cautionary, measured. Light weight on 「promise」—a gentle correction, not a lecture. Thoughtful pause before the second clause. Protective tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。冊子を製本する業者を選定中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently vetting binding vendors for the booklet.
lines.style: Reassuring progress report. Calm, steady. Light emphasis on 「vetting」—detail-oriented. Conversational, not rushed. Shows he's tracking the work.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィス用のスキャナを新調しましょう
lines.en: Let's get a new scanner for the office.
lines.style: Direct, practical. Brief opener. Clipped pace—efficiency over elaboration. No decoration. Matter-of-fact tone that invites quick agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。試験場の予約も完了しました
lines.en: Yes. I've also finished booking the test venue.
lines.style: Confident completion report. Slight lift on 「finished」—small satisfaction in ticking off another item. Tempo steady and efficient. No unnecessary words.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 防火訓練を定期的に行いましょう
lines.en: We should conduct fire drills on a regular schedule.
lines.style: Instructional, calm. Flat emphasis—this is important routine, not emergency. Even pace, slightly slower to ensure clarity. Responsible, unadorned tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の配色を社員に投票してもらいます
lines.en: Yes. I'll have the team vote on the product color options.
lines.style: Closing summary. Warm, cooperative finality. Light ease on 「vote」—collaborative touch, including staff in decision. Slightly slower tempo to signal we're wrapping up.
